title: Apple’s Narrowing Margins Overshadow Upbeat Holiday Forecast
summary:
Apple Inc. delivered a mixed outlook to investors in its first quarterly report under Chief Executive Officer John Ternus, with tightening profit margins overshadowing an upbeat sales forecast.
Dan Ives, Partner at Yorkville Ives & Co., discusses the AI buildout and recaps Apple and Palantir earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Can Apple Defend Its Premium?
summary: Apple’s 36x forward earnings valuation leaves little room for bad news. Craig Moffett, the Founding Partner and Senior Analyst at MoffettNathanson says slowing services growth, rising memory costs and iPhone supply limits are testing the story. He joins Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about why the new foldable is drawing interest and why it won’t solve Apple’s bigger ecosystem and growth questions. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Match Drops After Sales, Profit Outlook Miss Estimates
summary: Match Group Inc. disappointed investors after posting weaker-than-expected quarterly revenue and forecasting adjusted earnings that missed Wall Street estimates, suggesting it still has work to do in pulling off a long-promised turnaround.

title: Meta Seeks $15 Billion in First Leg of Cross-Border Fundraising
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is selling debt for the first time in six months, offering investors juicier yields as it seeks to lure buyers despite growing skepticism over Big Tech’s massive bet on artificial intelligence.

title: Google Parent Plans $1.5 Billion Prepaid Energy Deal via Goldman
summary: Google parent Alphabet Inc. is back in the municipal bond market for the second time this year with a $1.5 billion prepaid energy deal.

title: Midterms Threaten to Upend a Trump-Era Financial Market Order
summary: The second Trump administration has created a boon for a relatively new crop of financial companies in the digital finance industry. Some traders are positioning for that to change after Tuesday’s US midterm vote.

title: Quant Trader’s Criminal Trial to Spotlight Secretive Industry
summary: The criminal trial of a quantitative trader for allegedly stealing algorithmic trading code will also put a spotlight on the secretive industry in which he worked.

title: Binance Hackers Used Fake Job Interviews in Record Heist
summary: Binance Holdings Ltd. said Tuesday that the hackers behind a $6.3 billion heist used social engineering techniques including fake job interviews, as well as malicious software, in the most detailed report yet on how the incident unfolded.

title: Security Firm Tied to OpenAI, Anthropic AI Hacks Blames ‘Error’
summary: A spate of cyberattacks involving AI agents from some the world’s top model makers were down to an “error” and time pressures at Israeli security company Irregular Security, according to CEO Dan Lahav.

title: Palantir Outlook Signals Slowdown in AI-Fueled Sales Growth
summary: Palantir Technologies Inc., the AI-powered data and analytics platform that counts the US military among its chief customers, issued a quarterly outlook that pointed to a potential slowdown in sales growth.

title: Shopify Plunges as Revenue Misses for First Time Since 2022
summary: Shopify Inc. shares sank after its quarterly revenue missed analysts’ expectations for the first time in four years.

title: Goldman’s Molavi Says 60% of S&P 500 Is in Bear Market Territory
summary: The S&P 500 Index is within about 3% of its latest record high and yet 60% of the benchmark is languishing in bear market territory.

title: AI Minister Says the UK Isn’t Ready for ‘Extremely Likely’ Cyber Attacks
summary: The UK is “extremely likely” to experience a serious cybersecurity breach in the near future, according to the country’s AI minister Kanishka Narayan.

title: Palantir Growth Slows From Breakneck Pace
summary: Palantir Technologies expects revenue of roughly $2.65 billion in the three months ended Dec. 31. While that beat the $2.46 billion average of analysts’ estimates, the guidance translates into a roughly 15% quarter-over-quarter gain, falling well below the 20% increase the firm enjoyed in the last period. Ed Ludlow reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple iPhone Duo Isn't a Big Growth Driver, Craig Moffett Says
summary: Craig Moffett, founding partner and senior research analyst at MoffettNathanson, says the iPhone Duo appears to be off to a strong start, with availability constrained by supply and wait times extending into January. He acknowledges that reports of cracking screens are a reputational setback, but cautions against overemphasizing them. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple’s Narrowing Margins Overshadow Upbeat Holiday Forecast
summary: Apple Inc. delivered a mixed outlook to investors in its first quarterly report under Chief Executive Officer John Ternus, with tightening profit margins overshadowing an upbeat sales forecast.

title: Energy Transfer Approves $1.6 Billion Gas Pipe as AI Use Soars
summary: Energy Transfer LP formally committed to building a $1.6 billion pipeline that will move natural gas from eastern Louisiana across Mississippi, a move that comes as data centers and export terminals boost demand for the fuel.

title: How AI Is Changing Drug Discovery at Isomorphic Labs
summary: Max Jaderberg, President, Isomorphic Labs, discusses how AI is accelerating scientific discovery and opening new approaches to drug development with Bloomberg’s Shirin Ghaffary at the 2026 Bloomberg Tech in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Salesforce Sponsor Spotlight
summary: Paul O’Sullivan, Senior Vice President, Solution Engineering & Chief Technology Officer, United Kingdom & Ireland, Salesforce and Dave Williams, Chief Digital Officer, Trustpilot, discuss what it takes to scale software across the enterprise at the 2026 Bloomberg Tech in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Private Backers Step Back From Turkey’s Flagship EV Project at €800 Million Valuation
summary: Turkey’s sovereign wealth fund is buying stakes in Togg from two of the electric carmaker’s original investors, in deals that value President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s flagship industrial project at $900 million.
